Extracting sample info based on regex keywords

Source: R/sample_processing.R
keywords_to_info.Rd

Extracting sample info based on regex keywords found in a string. If multiple keywords are found, the first keyword found will be used to extract the info.

Usage

keywords_to_info(sample, keywords, info)

Arguments

sample

A string containing the sample info, must be a single string

keywords

A vector of regex keywords to search for

info

A vector of info represented by the keywords, must be the same length as keywords

Value

the info extracted from the sample based on the keywords found

Examples

# Extracting sample info based on regex keywords
sample <- "Sample_2wks_1"
keywords <- c("[0-9]wks", "p7")
info <- c("postnatal_2wks", "postnatal_day_7")

# Extracting the stage info
keywords_to_info(sample, keywords, info)
#>    Sample_2wks_1 
#> "postnatal_2wks"
